Messages.Author: Wade Lahoda
Messages.Body:
Hi there... I used to play way back when the game was called
Jyhad, and I have rediscovered how mind-numbling awesome this game is.
Just one question...I've looked at the errata on the White Wolf site. Is
this errata complete? If I've got my stack of old Jyhad cards and a
printout of this errata, do I have what I need? I ask, because I notice
some of the card changes highlighted in the card text listings are not
mentioned in the errata - this is, I assume, because they are not
important changes(ie: vote -> referendum. I think I can figure this out
by myself). But for instance I heard that Drawing out the Beast was
changed, yet I don't see it mentioned on the errata listing.

So, is the errata all I need to print out, or do I have to print
out all the card listings too? Should I just consider half my Jyhad
cards proxies from now on? ;)

A. Wade Lahoda
ab...@sfn.saskatoon.sk.ca

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ab...@sfn.saskatoon.sk.ca (Wade Lahoda) wrote:
> Hi there... I used to play way back when the game was called
> Jyhad, and I have rediscovered how mind-numbling awesome this game
is.
> Just one question...I've looked at the errata on the White Wolf site.
> Is this errata complete?

Yes (except for the short list of errata found in the Sabbat
War that haven't been added to the errata list yet - Power
Structure, Speed of Thought, and Creation Rites - which should
all be played as printed in the Sabbat expansion).

> If I've got my stack of old Jyhad cards and a
> printout of this errata, do I have what I need?

No - you also need the latest card texts.

> I ask, because I notice
> some of the card changes highlighted in the card text listings are not
> mentioned in the errata - this is, I assume, because they are not
> important changes(ie: vote -> referendum. I think I can figure this
> out by myself). But for instance I heard that Drawing out the Beast
> was changed, yet I don't see it mentioned on the errata listing.

It isn't errata, since the card function as per its latest printing.

> So, is the errata all I need to print out, or do I have to print
> out all the card listings too?

You need to have the latest card texts.
